mutation_proposal.mechanism_hypothesis: Within the dev-only, non-authoritative cost-aware CASH -> PILOT -> FULL family, the recap-confirm variant appears to preserve positive after-cost capture but over-triggers PILOT re-entries, which likely drove the switch_count_delta increase to 11, turnover_pressure_delta to 2.0, and the max_drawdown_delta_pct deterioration to -5.722469. Restricting PILOT entry frequency within each constructive window should reduce churn and drawdown pressure while retaining some of the earlier-entry benefit.

mutation_target.exact_change: Keep the CASH/PILOT/FULL states, 0.00/0.15/1.00 weights, recap-confirm setup persistence requirement, fresh benchmark/pilot recapture requirement, pilot_to_full rules, exit rules, and cost model unchanged; add one restriction only: permit at most one PILOT entry per constructive window.

mutation_proposal.stop_condition: Reject this single-rule mutation if validation still shows switch_count_delta > 4, turnover_pressure_delta > 0.0, max_drawdown_delta_pct < -1.0, net_cagr_delta_pct <= 0.0 after costs, or if the proposal expands beyond this one entry-frequency restriction.

openai_hook.selection_rationale: The already-selected family should remain unchanged except for one tighter entry restriction because the prior recap-confirm attempt improved net_cagr_delta_pct versus the earlier family artifact but violated the family stop condition through excess switching and worse drawdown. A single cap on PILOT entries is the narrowest mutation consistent with the observed failure mode, avoids a parameter sweep, stays within dev-only research scope, and does not mutate any source of truth.
